accessFormSections.defineOQueA: Sets what the person administers. There is only one, and they do not stack.

accessFormSections.osMesmosGruposDe: The same groups as in Rules. They are what decide which categories the person reaches.

blockAccessDialog.asSessoesAtivasNesta: Active sessions in this company will be revoked.
blockAccessDialog.esteUsuarioPerderaO: This user will lose access to this company. Their account will not be deleted, and access in other companies is not affected.

inviteMemberDialog.semNenhumGrupoA: With no group, the person gets in but reaches no document. Access is granted to the group, never to a person on their own.

company_admin.label: Company administrator

individual_admin.label: Account administrator
individual_admin.description: Manages access and documents for the individual account.

user.label: User
user.description: Accesses the documents and features they are granted.
